title: Core value lists
description: Closed value lists of /contracts v1. Each list is a distinct named type (OD-P-10). docs/engineering/state-registry.md is the single normative home; tools/contracts/validate.py fails when this file and the registry differ (DEC-2026-10-16 money-and-value-lists §2.4).

RetrySafety.description: SoT §43.8. NONE is never retried automatically (INV-24).

ConcurrencyControl.description: SoT §43.8. With CONDITIONAL_WRITE every write passes the grant's version tokens (INV-27).

ConsequenceLevel.description: SoT §43.8, for financial, customer, regulatory, access and operational.

EvaluationTime.description: SoT §15.3. AT_DECISION is the default. The policy author sets it; Trust never infers it.
